registration.admin.title: Sign-up by link
registration.admin.mode.label: Sign-up by link
registration.admin.mode.hint: People who have the link sign up with their name and email address, then check a code. Sign-ups close automatically at the draw.
registration.admin.link.title: Invitation link
registration.admin.link.label: Link to share
registration.admin.link.copy_failed: Copy failed: the link is selected, copy it by hand.
registration.admin.link.hidden: The link is shown only once, when you turn sign-up on or renew it. Renew it to get a new one.
registration.admin.qr.alt: QR code of the invitation link
registration.admin.qr.hint: For a family together: have them scan this code with a phone.
registration.admin.renew.confirm: Renew the link? The old link and its QR code stop working right away. People already signed up are not affected.
registration.admin.limits.title: Limits
registration.admin.limits.closes_hint: Without a date, sign-ups stay open until the draw.
registration.admin.pending.title: Waiting for verification
registration.admin.pending.hint: A code that is not entered expires after 48 h. For a relative less comfortable with technology, validate them yourself: their personal link is sent right away.
registration.admin.block.title: The draw is blocked while sign-ups are waiting.
registration.admin.block.text: Validate or delete them before running the draw.
registration.admin.closed.title: Sign-up by link is closed
registration.admin.closed.hint: The draw is done: the link no longer accepts anyone. To welcome a latecomer, use "Adjust the draw".
registration.admin.notice.renewed: New link created. The old one no longer works.
registration.admin.notice.validated: Sign-up validated: the personal link was sent by email.
registration.admin.err.too_soon: Wait a minute before asking for a new code.
registration.admin.err.limited: Too many requests. Try again a little later.
registration.admin.err.capacity: The number of places must be between 1 and 1000, and the date must be valid.
registration.admin.err.forbidden: Not possible in the group's current state.
